items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: when I went to Hobbs, at the Ramona nightclub, they're playing for Cecil Thompson

ctx.x: That's how Joe did MC'ing too, huh?

Yes, he did, and had one of the loveliest voice. Because he did the kids. Man, when he sing Cocktails for Two, that was popular in those years. And he couldn't set no chair, because he'd break all the chairs up. He'd just set right on the bandstand, just fall around, you know, on the bandstand, man. Oh, Mr. Five by Five, but he had a wonderful voice. That's true, though. Yeah. Well, I worked there, like I said, about a year. And then I hit on up in Hobbs, see? I went to Hobbs. That's New Mexico. Mm-hmm. And,…
Yeah, they had that bad thing.
